QuestInfo.name: Administrator's Apologies
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator wants to apologize about event errors on Jan. 11th and would like to compensate you for your inconvenience with 1 Double EXP item per day until Jan. 17th.
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator wants to apologize about event errors on Jan. 11th and would like to compensate you for your inconvenience with 1 Double EXP item per day until Jan. 17th.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Thank you for joining the January 1st Event. I was very surprised by the unexpected problem that occurred! I'm sorry that you weren't able to enjoy Maple World as much as you wanted.
0.1: To show you how sorry I am, I've prepared an item that will double your EXP for 1 hour. You can receive this item every day until Monday, January 17th, so don't forget to pick it up.

yes.0: It's not much, but I hope it's a good first step to making it up to you. I'll try really hard to make sure that this doesn't happen again! Please, give me another chance.

no.0: Don't you want to double your EXP? I know how upset you must be, but please accept our apology and accept our gift.
